sync.title: Sync with Tracker
sync.description: Pull the latest matches, upcoming fixtures, squad stats, transfers, and rankings straight from the club's tracker page and update this site to match. This also happens automatically once an hour in the background while the site's server is running — this button is only for forcing an update right now.
sync.successBody: Updated {players} players, {matches} matches, {fixtures} upcoming fixtures, {transfers} transfer log entries, and {rankings} ranking snapshots.
sync.problemsNote: This usually means the tracker changed its page layout, not that your data is wrong. Try again shortly, or ask for help updating the sync.
sync.genericError: Something went wrong reaching the sync. Please try again.
sync.preserves: Player photos, position/role, join date, favorite player, and the homepage-highlight flag are always kept. News, Gallery, and other teams' Standings rows are never touched.
sync.lastSynced: Last synced {time} — this also happens automatically once an hour, so you don't need to click the button yourself.
sync.neverSynced: Not synced yet. Click the button below, or wait up to an hour for the automatic sync to run.
